focus: mimo-02: The criteria-lint base rate, an independent sample (question 22)

label: The criteria-lint base rate is method-dominated: strict referential scoring gives 35/44 = 79.5% (Wilson 65.5-88.8), lenient 20/44 = 45.5% (31.7-59.9), against 1.5% regex and 28% one-lens; D5 is three failure definitions, not two estimates
Nearly every sampled violation is referential (definite description with an external antecedent like 'the run report' or 'every kept file'), a class lexical proxies structurally miss

R20's 5% stop rule cannot fire under any semantic rubric (lenient floor 31.7%); it needs a rubric-qualified replacement before 006's spec freezes
